{"type":"tool_use","timestamp":1794708008654,"sessionID":"ses_e231f465efferDAQ0PSyPl0Lsu","part":{"type":"tool","tool":"lightlag_rules","callID":"25KJgbC9ymL2CJlS","state":{"status":"completed","input":{},"output":"{\"version\":\"lightlag-traverse-v1\",\"delay_ticks\":3,\"max_ticks\":420,\"battery_capacity\":100.0,\"initial_battery\":100.0,\"idle_cost\":0.15,\"sample_cost\":2.0,\"target_radius\":2.5,\"base_radius\":4.0,\"solar_peak\":2.8,\"solar_efficiency_range\":[0.8,1.0],\"sun_margin_ticks\":56,\"supported_actions\":[\"drive\",\"sample\",\"wait\"],\"scripting_allowed\":true,\"first_execution_tick\":\"sent_tick + delay_ticks + 1; FIFO, one command per tick\",\"telemetry_arrival_tick\":\"state_tick + delay_ticks; tick 0 is the initial briefing\",\"max_commands_per_uplink\":5,\"max_metres_per_drive\":5.0,\"max_advance_ticks\":5,\"heading\":\"0 degrees east (+x), 90 north (+y); each executed drive travels at the commanded heading plus a heading error: a hidden bias, uniform in +-heading_bias_deg at launch, which takes a Gaussian random-walk step of heading_bias_walk_deg before every executed drive, plus independent Gaussian noise of heading_noise_deg; telemetry heading_deg reports the commanded heading\",\"ground\":\"map() gives elevation_cm[j][i], the height in centimetres at x = i * cell_m, y = j * cell_m, and terrain[j][i], the class code of the grid cell whose south-west corner is that vertex. Height between vertices is bilinear inside the cell. The slope at a point is the gradient of that bilinear surface: d/dx = ((h10 - h00) * (1 - ty) + (h11 - h01) * ty) / cell_m and d/dy = ((h01 - h00) * (1 - tx) + (h11 - h10) * tx) / cell_m, with tx, ty the point's fractions inside its cell and h10 the vertex to the east\",\"physics\":{\"segment_m\":0.25,\"max_tilt\":0.36,\"slip_base_ranges\":{\"bedrock\":[0.01,0.05],\"regolith\":[0.05,0.12],\"sand\":[0.15,0.35],\"rocks\":[0.12,0.24]},\"slip_grade_gain\":{\"bedrock\":0.8,\"regolith\":1.5,\"sand\":3.5,\"rocks\":1.2},\"slip_noise\":0.02,\"slip_max\":0.95,\"side_slip_gain\":{\"bedrock\":0.1,\"regolith\":0.3,\"sand\":0.8,\"rocks\":0.2},\"drive_cost_per_wheel_m\":{\"bedrock\":0.3,\"regolith\":0.36,\"sand\":0.5,\"rocks\":0.6},\"climb_cost_per_m\":2.0},\"drive\":\"a drive of M wheel metres is integrated in steps of segment_m, with the ground sampled where each step starts: grade = slope along the travelled heading, cross = slope to the left of it; slip = clip(slip_base[terrain] + slip_grade_gain[terrain] * max(0, grade) + noise, 0, slip_max), with slip_base[terrain] hidden inside slip_base_ranges and fixed for the mission, and noise one uniform draw in +-slip_noise per drive; the rover moves step * (1 - slip) along the heading and step * side_slip_gain[terrain] * cross to the right of it, which is downhill across the heading\",\"safety_stop\":\"a step that would leave the map, or end where the slope is steeper than max_tilt, is not taken: the rover stops at the last safe position and every queued command is cleared; their reserved ticks stay reserved\",\"energy\":\"each tick, in this order: the battery gains solar_peak * efficiency * sin(pi * (tick + sun_margin_ticks) / (max_ticks + 2 * sun_margin_ticks)), capped at battery_capacity, with efficiency hidden inside solar_efficiency_range and fixed for the mission; then idle_cost; then the command. A drive costs drive_cost_per_wheel_m[terrain] per wheel metre plus climb_cost_per_m per metre of height gained. A sample costs sample_cost, also when it fails. A battery that reaches 0 ends the rover for good\",\"sampling\":\"pay sample_cost; collect the nearest unsampled active target within target_radius; a discovered target is active from its appear tick\",\"sample_windows\":{\"late_fraction\":0.25,\"deadline\":\"deadline_tick per target in map(); null means no deadline\"},\"discoveries\":\"new targets appear mid-mission; a target_discovered event in the telemetry packet for its appear tick announces it, so it arrives delay_ticks later, and map() lists it from then on\",\"reward\":\"sum over sampled targets of value if the sample executed at or before deadline_tick, otherwise value * late_fraction; times 1 within base_radius of the lander, 0.5 alive elsewhere, 0 if the battery ran out; divided by the value of every target of the mission, discovered or not; scored at max_ticks\",\"sensing\":{\"position_noise_m\":1.0,\"visual_odometry_noise\":0.05,\"heading_bias_deg\":5.0,\"heading_bias_walk_deg\":0.2,\"heading_noise_deg\":1.5},\"telemetry\":\"one packet per tick: position = true position + Gaussian noise of position_noise_m per axis, clipped to the map (the tick-0 briefing is exact); battery and charge (the solar energy gained that tick) are exact; terrain is the class under the rover and tilt the slope there; wheel_odometry is the wheel metres of the drive and visual_odometry the ground distance moved * (1 + Gaussian noise of visual_odometry_noise)\",\"scoring_position\":\"sampling, the return to the lander and safety stops use the true position\",\"map_generator\":{\"width_m\":600.0,\"height_m\":400.0,\"cell_m\":5.0,\"relief_spacing_m\":[200.0,100.0,50.0,25.0,12.5],\"relief_amplitude_m\":[5.0,2.6,1.3,0.6,0.25],\"regional_tilt\":0.008,\"craters\":[3,5],\"crater_radius_m\":[22.0,60.0],\"crater_depth_ratio\":[0.19,0.24],\"crater_rim_ratio\":[0.03,0.05],\"crater_breaches\":[1,2],\"scarp_step_m\":[5.0,8.0],\"scarp_length_m\":[300.0,460.0],\"scarp_passes\":2,\"terrain_share\":{\"sand\":0.18,\"rocks\":0.12,\"bedrock\":0.15},\"sand_max_cell_slope\":0.1,\"initial_targets\":38,\"discoveries\":8,\"target_clusters\":5,\"cluster_targets\":[4,6],\"cluster_radius_m\":55.0,\"target_values\":[1,5],\"target_min_spacing_m\":15.0,\"target_min_base_distance_m\":35.0,\"deadline_share\":0.7,\"deadline_window\":[0.22,0.95],\"discovery_appear\":[30,0.68],\"discovery_window_ticks\":[60,130]},\"campaign\":{\"missions\":3,\"mission\":3,\"ticks_per_mission\":420,\"complete\":true,\"next_mission\":\"begins the moment the last tick of the mission in play passes: at its tick 0, on a new map, with the rover at that map's lander and a full battery. From then on rules, map, telemetry_log and uplink describe the new mission\",\"scoring\":\"each mission is scored as `reward` says; the campaign's score is the value credited in all missions divided by the value of every target of all of them\",\"after_the_last\":\"advance answers campaign_complete true and lets no time pass; uplink is refused\"}}","metadata":{"truncated":false},"title":"","time":{"start":1794708008645,"end":1794708008652}},"metadata":{"google":{"thoughtSignature":""}},"id":"prt_1dceeeebf001mdggjo2H6mWNQE","sessionID":"ses_e231f465efferDAQ0PSyPl0Lsu","messageID":"msg_1dceee26c001pjAiPWj4radhon"}}
